greatOneFurNotes.Whitetail Deer: jodi's Steam guide lists 3 furs. Kosa's All-In-One guide (updated 23 Mar 2025) lists Brown, Dark Brown, Tan and Piebald without the Fabled prefix, so 'Fabled Dark Brown' may also exist; not confirmed. thehuntercotw.wordpress.com lists 'Fabled Piebald'.
greatOneFurNotes.Himalayan Tahr: jodi's guide lists these 7 without a 'Fabled' prefix, unlike every other species there. In-game names may carry the prefix.
greatOneFurNotes.Red Fox: 9 names, which matches the patch notes' count of 9 variations.
greatOneFurNotes.Ring-Necked Pheasant: 8 names, which matches the patch notes' count of 8 variations. The guide spells the species 'Ringed-Neck Pheasant'.
greatOneFurNotes.Gray Wolf: 9 names, which matches the 9 variations in Patch 8.3.
greatOneFurNotes.Wild Boar: 9 names, which matches the 9 fur variations in Patch 8.4. 'Stripple' and 'Smolder' are spelled as in the source.
greatOneFurNotes.Jaguar: Names not found. A YouTube video title says 'All 7 Fabled Furs', so there are probably 7 variations, but none are named in any readable source.
greatOneFurNotes.Taruca: Names not found. Patch 9.3 (Sept 2026) announces the Great One without fur details.
greatOneFurNotes.Red Deer: Every source checked (jodi's guide, Kosa's guide, gameslikefinder, grokipedia) lists only Fabled Spotted. It appears to be the single Great One fur.
greatOneFurNotes.Mule Deer: The full list of 6 includes the 2 already in great-ones.json.

ammoNotes: Taken from thehuntercotw.wordpress.com's handgun ammo page. The first key in each group matches the aggregate name in weapons.json; the per-load names are as the source spells them. Both loads of each caliber have the same range. .44 matches the Moradi's .44 Magnum (3-8) in weapons.json, and .454 matches the existing weapon-level 4-9. The page is undated, so ranges may predate later patches.

Magpie Goose.notes: The Wild Register shows no schedule for Magpie Goose. The source lists no drinking zone, which is normal for birds (drink [] as in needzones.json). It warns that several groups may share a zone, so arrival and departure times vary.
